correctness.rationale: The exact zero-sum decomposition has multiplicities (v-1)+(v-1)+1=2v-1. Its singular values follow BB^T=(k-lambda)I+lambda J. Incidence part-contrast is strictly negative. The nonincidence q=2 part-contrast is negative at the spectral root; for q>=3 it has a unique earlier root in (0,1/q), while the spectral threshold is >1/q. Endpoint nullities and Hilbert ranks follow from the complete eigenvalue list. Analytic small-p expansions prove scale asymptotics. The standalone checker passes 40 centered-matrix spectral comparisons for four prime orders.

originality.rationale: The full sharp dual projective-plane and nonincidence-graph exponents, their sharp mode transition at order three, endpoint nullities and asymptotic scale separation were not found in inspected primary sources or related published-index results. Sánchez treats a general computational criterion and two-level complete bipartite distance metrics; Haemers et al. treat design graph spectra rather than these three-level powered-distance inequalities. This is a bounded self-review originality assessment, not exhaustive exclusion of older association-scheme formulations.

value.rationale: The dual incidence/nonincidence metrics of a projective plane are canonical natural metric families. Their exact Schoenberg positivity thresholds show a nontrivial q=2 to q>=3 mode switch, a jump in endpoint Hilbert embedding rank, and distinct q^-1/2 versus q^-2 asymptotic scales. These quantities directly decide the family of all-bandwidth positive-definite radial kernels and are not arbitrary numerical slices.
